blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls dropped to 0-2 in the women’s softball competition of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after absorbing a 10-1 loss to Chinese Taipei in five innings on Sunday. Despite taking the early lead with their lone run in the first inning, the Blu Girls would eventually go down big to remain winless through two days of competition at Anjo Softball Ground. Alyssa Marie Daniell’s single scored Nicole Hammoude in the top of the opening frame before the Blu Girls’ pitching couldn’t prevent the Taiwanese onslaught. […]...
